name: Scenario Q: Cold Lead Re-engagement
comments: Runs on the 15th of every month at 10:00 AM America/New_York (cron: 0 10 15 * *). Searches HubSpot for deals in the Closed Lost stage whose hs_lastmodifieddate is more than 30 days ago (limit 20). Iterates over each deal, fetches the associated contact's email and name, builds context from the deal name, calls OpenRouter Claude Sonnet 4-6 to write a warm 3-sentence re-engagement email, sends it via Resend FROM Brian directly (CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS / 'Brian at CWI AI') with a Calendly link, and adds a timestamped note to the HubSpot contact. Error handler sends a Resend alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL on any failure. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Schedule trigger — runs on the 15th of every month at 10:00 AM America/New_York. Cron: 0 10 15 * *. No input data — fires the scenario to kick off the monthly Closed Lost re-engagement sweep.

parameters.name: handleErrors
parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.notes: HubSpot HTTP POST search — POST to /crm/v3/objects/deals/search. Filters: dealstage = env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_LOST AND hs_lastmodifieddate < (now - 30 days, as Unix timestamp). Properties: dealname, hs_lastmodifieddate, associations.contacts. Limit 20. Returns array of deals in response.data.results.

Iterator — loops over each deal in 2.data.results. Emits one bundle per deal with properties: id, properties.dealname, properties.hs_lastmodifieddate, associations. Downstream modules (4–8) run once per deal.

parameters.label: Evaluate all states as errors (except for 2xx and 3xx)

metadata.notes: HubSpot HTTP GET — GET /crm/v3/objects/deals/{dealId}/associations/contacts using deal id from iterator (3.id). Returns list of associated contact IDs in response.data.results. The first contact ID (4.data.results[0].id) is used to fetch full contact details in module 4b (combined into this module by fetching contact properties directly via /contacts/{contactId} with ?properties=email,firstname,lastname,company).

SetVariable — builds context from module 3 (iterator) and module 4 (contact associations). Sets: deal_id, deal_name, contact_id (first associated contact), contact_email, contact_firstname, contact_lastname, contact_name (first name or 'there' as fallback), business_name (company property or deal name as fallback), reengagement_date (today formatted ET). Extracts business context from deal name for Claude prompt.

metadata.notes: OpenRouter HTTP POST — model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6. Prompt: write a warm 3-sentence re-engagement email to [contact_name] at [business_name] who looked at AI automation 30+ days ago but did not move forward. Times change — check in warmly and offer a no-pressure 15-min catch-up. Returns only the email body (no subject, salutation, or sign-off). max_tokens 300, temperature 0.75.

Subject: 'Checking in — things may have changed'. Body: salutation + Claude-generated 3-sentence body (module 6) + Calendly link (env.CALENDLY_LINK) + Brian sign-off. Plain text format for personal feel.

metadata.notes: HubSpot HTTP PATCH (via POST to /crm/v3/objects/notes) — creates a note on the contact (5.contact_id) with body 'Re-engagement email sent [reengagement_date]'. Associated to contact via associationTypeId 202 (note-to-contact, HUBSPOT_DEFINED). hs_timestamp set to current Unix time.

metadata.notes: Error Handler — Resend alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL on any scenario failure. From env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS. Includes error message, failed module, timestamp (America/New_York ET), deal name, deal ID, and contact email from module 5 for manual follow-up. handleErrors: false so this module itself does not recurse on error.

notes.content: Module 1: Schedule trigger — cron 0 10 15 * * — fires on the 15th of every month at 10:00 AM America/New_York.

Module 2: HubSpot HTTP POST search — /crm/v3/objects/deals/search — dealstage = env.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_LOST AND hs_lastmodifieddate < (now - 30 days). Properties: dealname, hs_lastmodifieddate, associations.contacts. Limit 20.
Module 3: Iterator — loops over each deal in 2.data.results. One bundle per deal.
Module 4: HubSpot HTTP GET — /crm/v3/objects/deals/{dealId}/associations/contacts — fetches associated contact IDs and properties (email, firstname, lastname, company) for the current deal.

Module 5: SetVariable — builds context: deal_id, deal_name, contact_id, contact_email, contact_firstname, contact_lastname, contact_name (firstname or 'there'), business_name (company or deal name), reengagement_date (today ET).
Module 6: OpenRouter HTTP POST — anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 — generates warm 3-sentence re-engagement email body for contact_name at business_name. Returns only the email body.

Module 7: Resend HTTP POST — FROM 'Brian at CWI AI <env.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS>'. TO: contact email. Subject: 'Checking in — things may have changed'. Body: salutation + Claude body + Calendly link + Brian sign-off. Plain text for personal feel.
Module 8: HubSpot HTTP POST (note) — creates note on contact (5.contact_id) with body 'Re-engagement email sent [date]'. associationTypeId 202 (note-to-contact).
Module 9: Error Handler — Resend alert to env.ADMIN_EMAIL on any failure. Includes error message, module, timestamp ET, deal name, deal ID, contact email for manual follow-up.

environment_variables.HUBSPOT_STAGE_CLOSED_LOST: HubSpot deal stage ID for the Closed Lost stage
environment_variables.OPENROUTER_API_KEY: OpenRouter API key for Claude access
environment_variables.OPENROUTER_REFERRER: HTTP-Referer header value for OpenRouter requests (e.g. https://cwiai.net)
environment_variables.RESEND_API_KEY: Resend API key for sending emails
environment_variables.CWI_ALERT_FROM_ADDRESS: Verified sender address used as Brian's direct from address (e.g. brian@cwiai.net)
environment_variables.CALENDLY_LINK: Full URL for booking a 15-min catch-up call with Brian
environment_variables.ADMIN_EMAIL: Brian's email address for internal alerts and error notifications
